claim: Loads a four-bar sample with chord, tab, and theory output.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo/; assert populated sample markup, chord cards, tab preview, and demo controls.

claim: Sample edits stay separate from a real draft.
sandbox: Create a normal draft, edit and reset the demo, leave demo, and assert the normal draft is unchanged.

claim: Markup shows chord, fretboard, interval, and scale views.
sandbox: Fresh demo sample; select every theory tab and assert its populated output.

claim: Major, minor, seventh, maj7, m7, diminished, augmented, sus2, sus4, and slash-bass chords are supported.
sandbox: Fresh demo; enter one of each documented chord form and assert ten rendered chord names.

claim: Transposing changes chord text and keeps tab fret numbers.
sandbox: Fresh demo; transpose a D exercise by two semitones and assert changed chords with unchanged tab text.

claim: A share link reloads an exercise from the URL fragment.
sandbox: Fresh demo; copy a share link and open it in a separate fresh browser context.

claim: Share links keep exercise text out of network requests.
sandbox: Record requests during a demo share action; assert same-origin URLs without exercise query or fragment text.

claim: Drafts stay in browser storage and persist after reload.
sandbox: Fresh demo; edit the draft, reload, and assert the edited markup and populated result remain.

claim: Clear removes a draft and Undo clear restores it in the same session.
sandbox: Fresh demo; clear the sample and undo the clear action.

claim: Works offline after the first visit and keeps editing available.
sandbox: Dedicated fresh browser context at /demo/; wait for the service worker, set offline, reload, and edit.

claim: The editor has no account, upload, advertising, analytics, or third-party requests.
sandbox: Record the complete demo flow; assert GET-only same-origin requests and no account, upload, or payment controls.

claim: The tool has no audio playback, song catalog, or full-score engraving controls.
sandbox: Fresh demo; assert no audio, video, catalog, or score controls, then inspect the stated scope on home.

claim: Exercises up to 8,000 characters are shareable; larger input gets a recovery message.
sandbox: Fresh demo; share a valid 8,000-character exercise and assert the explicit error at 8,001 characters.

claim: The core editor is free to use without a payment or account step.
sandbox: Fresh demo; assert the sample editor is immediately editable with no payment or account control.

claim: Node.js 20 or newer builds the static entry point in dist/index.html.
sandbox: Installed clean checkout; build the product and assert the Node version and dist/index.html outcome.

claim: The static build serves restrictive response policies, immutable assets, and a designed 404 page.
sandbox: Built static server; assert route titles, CSP, cache policies, and the deliberate 404 response.
